operations.description: single-episode detail fetch; every field it returns is already emitted by the episodes list stream (GET /api/{podcast_id}/episodes.json returns the full episode set with the identical shape), and Buzzsprout has no per-episode incremental/webhook signal that would make a targeted single-record read useful beyond the list sync
operations.approval: not implemented: the direct-read executor has no non-redacting output policy for this provider operation
